title: LatexDo 0.3.1
summary: Updates that follow every build, a PDF builder that installs itself, and a clearer first run.

highlights.title: Updates follow every build
highlights.description: LatexDo now recognises a newer build even when the version number is the same, and confirms after restarting that the new build is really the one running.

highlights.title: The PDF builder installs itself
highlights.description: If this computer has no TeX distribution, setup downloads and verifies one for you, with a single progress bar and time remaining.

highlights.title: A tour that shows you
highlights.description: Each tour step is one sentence, highlights the real control, and Show me performs the step in your own project without changing your document.

fixes: Fixed the file picker not appearing the first time @ is typed in the AI composer.
Fixed tour steps that highlighted nothing or could not be completed.
Fixed Linux AppImage startup on desktops that restrict unprivileged user namespaces.

security.title: Automatic installation requires a signed update
security.description: LatexDo only installs an update automatically when it is signed by LatexDo. Unsigned update information can only open the downloads page.

security.title: Update signing key rotated
security.description: Updates are now signed with a new key. Earlier builds update once through the downloads list and then trust the new key.
